title: Normalization flow and Poincaré-Dulac theory
summary: In this article, we develop a new approach to the Poincaré--Dulac normal form theory for a system of differential equations near a singular point. Using the continuous averaging method, we construct a normalization flow that moves a vector field to its normal form. We prove that, in the algebra of formal vector fields (given by power series), the normalization procedure achieves full normalization.
